groups.problem: If the derived English counterpart properties file is missing or its path can't be resolved, a RuntimeException is thrown and the whole verification aborts.
groups.rationale: All three point at lines 73-80 and describe the same unhandled missing-English-file crash, with similar fixes (fall back to an empty bundle or report the problem properly).

groups.problem: The common prefix and suffix calculations can overlap, so substring gets start > end and throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same overlap bug in the diff-trimming loop and propose the same bound on the suffix scan.

groups.problem: The Lithuanian totpStep1 and loginTotpStep1 entries were replaced with an Italian string.
groups.rationale: The same wrong Italian text was pasted into both the account and login Lithuanian files. S8 names both places, and one translation fix resolves all of them.

groups.problem: totpStep1 in zh_CN uses Traditional Chinese characters instead of Simplified Chinese.
groups.rationale: Same line and same problem, with the same fix: convert the text to Simplified Chinese.
